title: Counting Bits
summary: Build a table of how many 1 bits each number from 0 to n has.
followUps: Can you fill the table in O(n) time, using entries already filled instead of counting each number's bits from scratch?
How would you use a small table like this to count the 1 bits of any 32-bit value?
How would you find the total number of 1 bits from 0 to n without building the table?
